findings.title: Stage延後與review-only parked判定未完成
findings.counterexample: 同為fixed result/released Writer/pending review，一項是額外Stage彙總，另一項是必需Source/Profile使用保證；尚無完成predicate區分。P3 prospective fixture僅用policy flags放行，沒有驗review type、required-before、frozen、writer_released。
findings.minimum_correction: 固定review分類、可park充分條件、不可延後項、最遲補審／blocking gate及與current priority/barrier的精確precedence；補must-reject反例。
findings.closure: Exact fixed successor + source-bound parked predicate and applicable positive/negative cases; qualified fresh narrow semantic review; no new Machine enum.
findings.unchanged: Existing B3 architecture,96 specs, original Unit/Wave/Human gates and current fail-closed behaviour.

findings.title: Bounded Batch Grant未定義
findings.counterexample: 批准有限集合{MA02-U01,MA02-U05}後，A消耗授權，未定義B的未消耗項/native authorization、partial failure/source revision drift、撤權與防止envelope重用。P1只測不同Unit各自不同mock Grant，沒有Batch。
findings.minimum_correction: 固定有限集合binding、逐Unit eligibility/scope/Profile/budget、單次消耗與partial completion/revocation/drift/resume；精確對接既有native lifecycle，不轉授具名WO correction authority。
findings.closure: Operational bounded authorization contract and exact native lifecycle expression verified with bounded batch positive/negative cases; no96 actual Grants needed for policy review.
findings.unchanged: Single Writer, per-autonomous-run package boundary, original Review barrier and all actual-use qualifications.

findings.title: 未審candidate到下游candidate的使用契約未定義
findings.counterexample: A=MA02-U01未審immutable candidate，B=MA02-U05另有candidate Grant；仍無可放行的candidate consumption條件。P5兩個Lane都要求Accepted上游，只證明拒絕。
findings.minimum_correction: 若涵蓋串接，固定允許/禁止scope、immutable input/Grant/consumer binding、衍生追蹤、上游失敗或修訂的下游處置及promotion barrier；若只涵蓋獨立工作，明確維持candidate-to-candidate禁止並縮限adoption claim。
findings.closure: Explicit fixed scope decision and candidate-only consume/deny rule with appropriate cases; no pending input becomes formal Accepted dependency.
findings.unchanged: Current conservative refusal is compliant, not an accepted-B3 defect; mandatory qualification/review/acceptance boundaries remain.

correction_owner: Original Architecture/Governance Owner, not independent Reviewer
